purpose: Contrato preliminar; no constituye una API de producción.

card_history.type: ordered list of prior transactions for the same card
card_history.order: ascending timestamp; transaction_id breaks exact timestamp ties
card_history.constraint: Only events strictly prior to the current transaction may be used. Labels and fraud metadata are forbidden.

derived_model_inputs: 23 causal aggregate features listed in model_a_metadata.json

output.decision_rule: block if risk_score >= threshold; otherwise allow

limits: operational review is needed before automatic blocking
